items.title: Procter & Gamble Earnings Beat Estimates. This Warning Sends the Stock Lower.
items.summary: Procter & Gamble  stock declined Wednesday as Wall Street reacted to mixed quarterly earnings and underwhelming profit guidance from the consumer packaged goods company.  Procter & Gamble posted core earnings of $1.43 a share for the fiscal fourth quarter, down from $1.48 a year ago but slightly above Wall Street expectations of $1.41.  It was a mixed bag for Procter & Gamble’s product categories—which range from baby care to hair care.
